name: Colton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Colton, CA 2026
seo_desc: Colton and Grand Terrace Christmas events for kids in 2026: Winter Wonderland, Light Up Grand Terrace and a library Santa luau, with dates and times.
lede: Colton and neighboring Grand Terrace spread their Christmas across city parks, a church lawn on Barton Road and the library, with a tree lighting and a park festival in the first half of December.
celebrates: Colton celebrates Christmas with a city Winter Wonderland at Fleming Park, where the Community Services department lists a Kid Zone, arts and crafts and a walk through story time. Next door, the City of Grand Terrace opens its season with Light Up Grand Terrace, a free evening with a Christmas tree lighting and Christmas Cruise at 6:30 pm. The Grand Terrace Branch Library adds Santa's Happy Hula-Day, a winter luau with games, crafts and photos with Santa. Downtown Colton also holds a Christmas parade on Valley Boulevard, which is organized by the Colton Chamber of Commerce.
lastyear: In 2025 downtown Colton held its 49th annual Christmas parade on Saturday, December 13, organized by the Colton Chamber of Commerce, according to the chamber's event page. The parade brings local organizations, schools and performers to Valley Boulevard in the heart of the city, and families have made it a yearly tradition for nearly half a century. The City of Colton lists a Winter Wonderland at Fleming Park the same day, giving children a chance to visit a Kid Zone and join crafts.
facts: Colton is nicknamed the Hub City because of its long history as a railroad junction in the Inland Empire, and the Colton Chamber of Commerce marks the holidays with a parade that has run for nearly fifty years, according to the chamber's page. Grand Terrace, just north of Colton, is a small city whose library branch on Barton Road and church grounds on the same road both host holiday events. Fleming Park, at 525 North La Cadena Drive, is the city's Winter Wonderland location.
trains: Colton earned its Hub City nickname from the railroads that cross the city, and freight trains still pass through town, which delights children who watch them from a safe distance. For a holiday train ride, the Southern California Railway Museum in Perris runs vintage trains in the Inland Empire, and families can also ride Metrolink from nearby San Bernardino. Check each railroad's own site for holiday dates and prices.
traditions: The city's midday family festival at Fleming Park with a Kid Zone, crafts and story time.
A free evening tree lighting and Christmas Cruise at Azure Hills Church.
Santa photos, games and crafts at the Grand Terrace Branch Library.
The chamber of commerce parade through downtown Colton on Valley Boulevard.
kidfact: Colton is called the Hub City because so many railroads meet there, so it is a great town to spot trains.
faq: When is Winter Wonderland in Colton in 2026?
The City of Colton holds Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 am to 1:30 pm at Fleming Park, 525 North La Cadena Drive.
When is the Grand Terrace tree lighting?
Light Up Grand Terrace is on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 4 to 8 pm at Azure Hills Church, with the tree lighting and Christmas Cruise at 6:30 pm. Admission is free.
Where can kids see Santa in Grand Terrace?
The Grand Terrace Branch Library holds Santa's Happy Hula-Day on Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 3 to 5 pm, with photo opportunities with Santa.
Is there a Christmas parade in Colton?
The Colton Chamber of Commerce runs a downtown Christmas parade on Valley Boulevard. Check the chamber at 909 825 2222 for the 2026 schedule, since its web page still shows the 2025 date.
Where can I find more Christmas events near Colton?
San Bernardino, Rialto, Redlands and Loma Linda are close by, and each has a guide on this site.
